status.current: present at the banquet with Moroboshi and Jounosaki

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Bukyoku teammate; jokingly calls him a sister-con.
relationships.byakuya-jounosaki: Bukyoku teammate from the previous year's podium.

periods.summary: Asagi appears at the banquet with Moroboshi and Jounosaki. She is introduced as the previous tournament's third-place finisher and supports the pressure on Akatsuki during Tatara's attempted violence.

key_events.summary: Appears with the Bukyoku podium trio when Moroboshi intervenes.
